label: SQL migration linter (squawk)
description: squawk (Apache-2.0, in the tools image) lints the SQL migration files of the workspace for operations that are risky on a live PostgreSQL (locks, required fields without a default, non-concurrent indexes): errors are blocking findings and warnings are reported without blocking. It reads the files only, so it needs no services. Comes in by evidence: SQL files in migrations/ or db/migrations/; runs only where migration is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
